defectsInvestigated.evidence: Evidence D - CIP Presentation Display (Not Responding)
defectsInvestigated.confirmedBy: direct code trace: display_presentation opens the display window then immediately commits activation and emits PRESENTATION_STARTED in Rust; PresentationDisplay.tsx had no state source other than that live event listener, which its own JavaScript subscribes to only after loading asynchronously on the new webview - an event fired before that subscription completes was lost permanently
defectsInvestigated.fix: PresentationDisplayState (get_presentation_display_state's existing response type) gains activeSlide: Option<RenderedSlide>, computed via the same already-tested render_content function; PresentationDisplay.tsx pulls this once on mount

defectsInvestigated.evidence: Related to Evidence D - display window reopen failures
defectsInvestigated.confirmedBy: direct code trace: close_presentation_display only closed the window; the active item's Stopped reconciliation only happened via the window's own asynchronous Destroyed event handler, which is not guaranteed to complete before the command returns to the frontend
defectsInvestigated.fix: close_presentation_display now calls the existing, already-idempotent clear_active_presentation synchronously before closing the window

notVerified.claim: the exact mechanism behind the literal Windows 'Not Responding' title-bar text
notVerified.reason: this environment has no WinDbg, ETW, or physical Windows access to inspect a hung window's message loop; the fixes above address the most plausible proximate causes (provable independently by code reading) but this session does not claim to have reproduced or confirmed the exact Windows-side failure mode
notVerified.requiredToConfirm: a real Windows re-test of this rebuilt artifact, per the phase's own final gate

limitations: Both fixes are Tauri-command-layer glue (AppHandle/WebviewWindow orchestration) which this project has no tauri::test harness for (a pre-existing, documented convention). The tests above prove the underlying invariants at the layer this project's automated tests can reach; the actual Tauri command ordering and any Windows-specific WebView2 behavior remain unverified without a physical Windows re-test.
